about: Synthetic Route 53 seed for the twin, account 111122223333. Proposal for site/twin/data/route53.json. Route 53 is global: one endpoint, route53.amazonaws.com, signed as us-east-1. example.com is reserved for documentation (RFC 2606).

records.Name: old.example.com.
records.finding: Made by no stack, and points at an S3 website bucket (old.example.com) that is not in the account: a dangling name. The map warns on it; removing it is a plan for aws.c and the owner's Approve.

notes: NS names above are placeholders in AWS's naming shape, not real name servers to be queried.
The alias's AliasTarget.HostedZoneId is left out on purpose: CloudFront's fixed alias zone id should be copied from AWS's documentation by whoever lands this, not from memory.
SOA and NS are what Route 53 makes with every public zone; the map lists them but does not treat them as 'serving' anything.
